title: Quote: (about Microsoft) They are shamelessly trying to copy us. I ...
speaker: Steve Jobs
event: Apple CEO slams environmentalists at annual meeting
content: (about Microsoft) They are shamelessly trying to copy us. I think the most telling thing is that Tiger will ship at the end of the month and Longhorn is still two years out. They can't even copy fast.
